description.summary: You unleash a torrent of sounds into the mind of your target, forcing the words to spill from their lips but only the ones you truly wish to hear.
description.value: You unleash a torrent of sounds into the mind of your target, forcing the words to spill from their lips but only the ones you truly wish to hear. If the target fails their Will save they cannot tell any form of lie and when asked a question must provide a truthful answer to the bard. When the target is asked a question they do not know the answer to they will state as such. This is a painful experience if the target tries to resist, most would attribute it to torture and is often looked down on by society. For every round they try to resist they take nonlethal damage equal to the bard’s caster level.
